restated_task: Add an instance method `Version.is_compatible(other: Version) -> bool` to the `Version` class in `src/semver/version.py`. The method returns True when `other` (the new version) can be used in place of `self` (the old version). Compatibility rules: majors must be equal; new.minor >= old.minor; prerelease parts must be equal (both absent counts as equal); patch is ignored. Major version 0 is special: only identical versions (major, minor, patch, prerelease all equal) are compatible. If `other` is not a `Version` instance (subclasses allowed), raise `TypeError` with a message starting with 'Expected a Version type'. Include a docstring with at least two doctest examples. Do not modify any other public behavior, tests, docs, or packaging files; the existing pytest suite must continue to pass.

interface_contract.name: Version.is_compatible
interface_contract.behavior: Returns True when `other` (new version) can be used in place of `self` (old version). Compatibility rules: (1) `self.major == other.major`; (2) `other.minor >= self.minor`; (3) `self.prerelease == other.prerelease` (both None counts as equal); (4) `self.patch` and `other.patch` are ignored. Special case: if `self.major == 0`, compatibility requires exact equality of major, minor, patch, and prerelease (build is still ignored). Subclasses of `Version` are accepted as `other`.
error_cases: TypeError with message starting with 'Expected a Version type' if `other` is not an instance of `Version` (or a subclass thereof).

acceptance_criteria: Version(0, 1, 0).is_compatible(Version(0, 1, 1)) is False (major 0 requires identical patch)
Version(1, 2, 3).is_compatible('wrongtype') raises TypeError with message starting 'Expected a Version type'
Version(1, 2, 3).is_compatible({'a': 2}) raises TypeError with message starting 'Expected a Version type'
Version(1, 2, 3).is_compatible([]) raises TypeError with message starting 'Expected a Version type'
class CustomVersion(Version): pass; CustomVersion(1, 0, 0).is_compatible(Version(1, 0, 0)) is True (subclass accepted)
The method's docstring contains at least two doctest examples
